cues: In the dark, a red cigar point comes up the gravel walk.
Gouvernail sits down, and half to himself he quotes Walt Whitman: night of south winds, night of the large few stars.
Whitman was America's great poet of the body and of open desire, so the quotation says what the characters cannot.
Then he talks of his old ambitions, and of what is left: only a wish to exist, with now and then a little whiff of genuine life.
